IBM's SDE field-name reference for this stream could not be fetched, so the source field names are unknown and no ECS/custom mapping is applied - a documented sourcing gap, not a guessed mapping.

conf.comment: RACF command audit via CDPz SDE JSON (dataset=racf-command, format=json). Work order's own fields_omitted note: 'The SDE field names differ from the <col_id>_ columns and are publicly documented but were not fetchable here, so the table is empty.' Per the brief's rule against guessing unguessable field names, this pipeline does the one thing it can do without inventing a key name - unpack the JSON structurally - and stops there. Do not add ECS mapping to this file without first confirming the real SDE field names against IBM's SMF-80 data stream reference or a captured sample.

functions.description: Structurally extract the CDPz-emitted JSON object into event fields, whatever keys the SDE subset for this record happens to carry
Tag the dataset so records land in the shared logs-zos_racf.command data stream alongside the IRRADU00 and LEEF producers, even though field-level ECS mapping is deferred
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
